description.login: Sign in to your Disscount account.
description.forgot: We'll send you a link to reset your password.

credentials.legal: By continuing, you accept our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

signup.inboxDescription: We sent an email with a link to finish signing up to:

forgot.inboxDescription: If an account exists for that address, we sent a link to set a new password to:
forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sendError: Couldn't send the link. Try again.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.description: Set a new password for your Disscount account.
resetPassword.missingToken: The reset token is missing. Request a new link with “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in screen.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
resetPassword.success: Password set. You can now sign in.

emailVerified.title: Email confirmed
emailVerified.description: Your email address is confirmed. Great to have you here!

emailChanged.title: Email changed
emailChanged.description: Your new email address is confirmed and active.

social.error: Couldn't sign in with {provider}. Try again.

errors.emailNotVerified: Your email isn't confirmed yet. We sent you a new link. Check your email (and your spam folder).
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.passwordBreached: This password appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.

validation.usernameMin: Username must be at least 2 characters
validation.usernameMax: Username can be at most 40 characters
validation.passwordTooShort: Your password needs at least 12 characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: Your password can have at most 128 characters.

breached.title: This password turned up in a data breach
breached.explanation: The password is correct, but it appeared in a known data breach from another site, so we didn't sign you in. We've sent a link to set a new password to:
breached.afterReset: Once you set a new password, we'll sign you out on every device. The link works for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} after it's sent. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder or ask for a new one.
breached.resent: We've sent a new link. You can ask for another in a minute.
breached.canResend: You can ask for the link again.

passwordHint: {min} to {max} characters. We don't accept passwords from known data breaches.
